headline: Toyo suspends US imports of Ethiopian-made solar cells amid tariff probe
summary: Japanese solar manufacturer TOYO Co. halted imports into the US of solar cells manufactured at its Ethiopian plant, citing regulatory uncertainty regarding a US Department of Commerce circumvention investigation into Chinese components.
why: Trade circumvention probes by the US Department of Commerce can result in substantial retroactive tariffs on clean energy hardware assembled in third-party countries.

impacts.name: TOYO Co.
impacts.why: Shipment suspensions to its major US export market disrupt revenue generation from its Ethiopian factory.
